name: repo-docs
description: Skills for how a repository writes down its rules, decisions and briefs: rules files per area, comments that follow the Google Go Style Guide with no citations, and the issue as the brief.

interface.shortDescription: Rules files, citation-free comments, issue briefs
interface.longDescription: Skills for how a repository writes down its rules, decisions and briefs. docs-reset migrates a repository, in small reviewable PRs that stop for the owner, from ADRs and citation-heavy comments to .claude/rules files per area, comments that follow the Google Go Style Guide with no citations or history (with Go-specific guidance and a gocomments tool for Go repositories), issues that are the complete brief for a session, and a PR reviewer that keeps it from drifting.
defaultPrompt: Migrate this repository off its ADRs.
Check this repository still follows the docs reset.
